create_MujocoEnv: create a MuJoCo environment by subclassing MujocoEnv and implementing get_obs_dict and get_reward_dict
run_examine_policy: run a policy on a MuJoCo environment with offscreen rendering to generate rollout videos
compute_path_rewards: compute vectorized rewards for a set of rollout paths and check for done conditions
evaluate_success: evaluate policy success percentage across multiple rollout paths with configurable successful steps threshold
render_camera_offscreen: render offscreen images from specified cameras at given resolution for visual observation collection
